caption: The drawing features a detailed, expressive human face with pronounced facial features including raised eyebrows, wide eyes, a prominent nose, and an open mouth with visible teeth. The face has curly hair and is surrounded by a large, ruff-like collar consisting of seven petal-shaped sections radiating outward. The collar sections are defined by dark lines and shaded with a combination of light and darker tones to suggest volume and shadow. The face and collar are rendered in a monochromatic palette, using shades of gray with slight hints of pinkish or beige tones for depth. The background consists of a plain setting enclosed by a rectangular border, with cross-hatched shading in the corners. The entire composition is executed with visible pencil or charcoal lines, giving the image a textured, hand-drawn look.
title: Wood Carving - "Hexafoos"
